description: This file provides German localization strings for the Select2 library version 4.0.6-rc.1, defining translations for various UI messages and error notifications used within the select2 plugin.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when results fail to load.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns the message prompting the user to input fewer characters when too many characters are entered.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns the message prompting the user to input more characters when too few characters are entered.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message indicating more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns the message indicating the maximum number of selections allowed.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when no matching results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message displayed while searching for results.
